title_en: Near the former park, 2+1 apartment for sale, ideal investment opportunity!!
description_en: Near the former park, 2+1 apartment for sale, ideal investment opportunity!! The apartment with an area of ​​85 m2 Net, is located on the 1st floor of a new building. It is an ideal investment opportunity, referring to the area where it is located and the increase in rents that the area has known. Has regular mortgage documentation.
